records.jp: かんながいなくなった！？
records.en_original: Kanna's gone missing?!
records.en: Kanna's gone missing?!

records.jp: うん、寮のどこにもいなくて――
records.en_original: Yeah, she's nowhere in the dorm.
records.en: Yeah, she's nowhere in the dorm.

records.jp: 私からもフリスぺや電話してみたけど繋がらなかった
records.en_original: I tried calling her on FreeSpace and her phone too, but I couldn't get through.
records.en: I tried calling her on FreeSpace and her phone too, but I couldn't get through.

records.jp: 最近の感じからすると……ただ学校をサボって<CR>遊びに行ったわけじゃないよね、きっと
records.en_original: Given how she's been lately, she probably didn't just skip school to go hang out somewhere.
records.en: Given how she's been lately, she probably didn't just skip school to go hang out somewhere.

records.jp: でも、この前の任務で憂さ晴らしした後は<CR>元気そうにしてたのに……
records.en_original: But after blowing off some steam on the last mission, she seemed like she was back to normal.
records.en: But after blowing off some steam on the last mission, she seemed like she was back to normal.

records.jp: よかった、みんないてくれて
records.en_original: Thank goodness you're all here!
records.en: Thank goodness you're all here!

records.jp: ひ、日菜子！？<CR>どうしたの、そんな慌てて……
records.en_original: H-Hinako?! What's going on, why are you so flustered?
records.en: H-Hinako?! What's going on, why are you so flustered?

records.jp: 大変なことになってて。<CR>今、世界中で異灰が大量発生してるの
records.en_original: It's bad. There's a massive outbreak of Testa happening all over the world right now.
records.en: It's bad. There's a massive outbreak of Testa happening all over the world right now.

records.jp: 世界中！？
records.en_original: All over the world?!
records.en: All over the world?!

records.jp: そしてコズミックファングも、<CR>かつてないほどクイーンの侵攻を受けている
records.en_original: And the Cosmic Fang is facing the worst Queen invasion we've ever seen.
records.en: And the Cosmic Fang is facing the worst Queen invasion we've ever seen.

records.jp: このままだとコモンまで侵食されて、<CR>この世界がなくなっちゃう
records.en_original: At this rate, even the Common will be taken over, and this world could disappear.
records.en: At this rate, even the Common will be taken over, and this world could disappear.

records.jp: なくなるって……
records.en_original: Disappear?
records.en: Disappear?

records.jp: 文字通りだよ。異灰に食われて、無になる
records.en_original: I mean it, literally. The Testa will consume everything and turn it to nothing.
records.en: I mean it, literally. The Testa will consume everything and turn it to nothing.

records.jp: だから私は、今度こそコズミックファングに行って<CR>クイーンの侵攻を阻止する
records.en_original: That's why I'm going to the Cosmic Fang this time, and I'm going to stop the Queen invasion.
records.en: That's why I'm going to the Cosmic Fang this time, and I'm going to stop the Queen invasion.

records.jp: それなら、わたしも……！
records.en_original: If that's the case, let me come too!
records.en: If that's the case, let me come too!

records.jp: みんなには、近くのＨＬＡＡ＿０１地区で<CR>待機していてもらいたいの
records.en_original: I want the rest of you to wait in the HLAA_01 district nearby.
records.en: I want the rest of you to wait in the HLAA_01 district nearby.

records.jp: 少しでもクイーンがコズミックファングに<CR>近づかないように、防いでほしい
records.en_original: Please try to keep the Queens from getting anywhere near the Cosmic Fang, even just a little.
records.en: Please try to keep the Queens from getting anywhere near the Cosmic Fang, even just a little.

records.jp: わたしたちも行かせて！
records.en_original: Let us go too!
records.en: Let us go too!

records.jp: だって、わたしたちが奪還して、日菜子をユズさん、<CR>ライムさんと会わせるって約束したんだよ！
records.en_original: After all, I promised that we would take the Cosmic Fang back and that you would be reunited with Yuzu and Lime!
records.en: After all, I promised that we would take the Cosmic Fang back and that you would be reunited with Yuzu-san and Lime-san!

records.jp: でも、今のコズミックファングは危険だから――
records.en_original: But the Cosmic Fang is really dangerous right now...
records.en: But the Cosmic Fang is really dangerous right now...

records.jp: コズミックファング……っ！！
records.en_original: The Cosmic Fang...
records.en: The Cosmic Fang...

records.jp: 大変……もしかしたらかんな、<CR>コズミックファングに行ったのかも！
records.en_original: Oh no... Kanna might have gone to the Cosmic Fang!
records.en: Oh no... Kanna might have gone to the Cosmic Fang!

records.jp: 少し前に、なんだかいつもと違う様子で<CR>コズミックファングを見つめてたの
records.en_original: A little while ago, she was staring at the Cosmic Fang with a look I've never seen before.
records.en: A little while ago, she was staring at the Cosmic Fang with a look I've never seen before.

records.jp: ……思いつくところは全部探していなかった。<CR>だとすると、可能性は高いと思う
records.en_original: We've already searched everywhere else we could think of. So, I think there's a good chance.
records.en: We've already searched everywhere else we could think of. So, I think there's a good chance.

records.jp: 同感。そういうわけだから白井、<CR>わたしたちも待機してらんなくなったわ
records.en_original: Agreed. That settles it, Hinako. We can't just sit around and wait either.
records.en: Agreed. That settles it, Hinako. We can't just sit around and wait either.

records.jp: リーダー、駒川さんはどうする？<CR>たしか今、本部に呼び出されてるんだよね？
records.en_original: Leader, what about Uta? She was called to HQ, wasn't she?
records.en: Leader, what about Komagawa-san? She was called to HQ, wasn't she?

records.jp: 「呼び戻す必要はない。不安要素は減らしたい」
records.en_original: No need to call her back. I want to reduce any uncertainty.
records.en: No need to call her back. I want to reduce any uncertainty.

records.jp: 同感……リーダーの支配下に置かれていても、<CR>気を許せない人だし
records.en_original: I agree... Even being under the Leader's control, she's not someone we can totally trust.
records.en: I agree... Even being under the Leader's control, she's not someone we can totally trust.

records.jp: コズミックファングに行く以上、準備も必要だ。<CR>一度司令室に向かおう
records.en_original: If we're going to the Cosmic Fang, we'll need to prepare. Let's head to the command room first.
records.en: If we're going to the Cosmic Fang, we'll need to prepare. Let's head to the command room first.

records.jp: あやかお姉ちゃんは、作戦のために本部へ行ったよ
records.en_original: Ayaka went to headquarters to strategize.
records.en: Ayaka went to headquarters to strategize.

records.jp: 久しぶり、ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Long time no see, Hina.
records.en: Long time no see, Hina.

records.jp: ライム……！
records.en_original: Lime!
records.en: Lime!

records.jp: うそ、こんなところで会えるなんて
records.en_original: I can't believe we'd run into each other here!
records.en: I can't believe we'd run into each other here!

records.jp: ずっと、ずっと、探してた。<CR>もう会えないんじゃないかって、何度も思ったけど
records.en_original: I've been searching and searching for you. I started to think I'd never see you again, more times than I can count.
records.en: I've been searching and searching for you. I started to think I'd never see you again, more times than I can count.

records.jp: 諦めなくてよかった……
records.en_original: I'm so glad I didn't give up...
records.en: I'm so glad I didn't give up...

records.jp: 本当は顔を出すかどうか、すごく悩んだんだけど……<CR>もうそういう時期じゃないから
records.en_original: I actually spent ages trying to decide whether to show my face or not... But it's just not the time for that anymore.
records.en: I actually spent ages trying to decide whether to show my face or not... But it's just not the time for that anymore.

records.jp: どういうこと？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: ごめんね。<CR>実は、ヒナちゃんが出雲に来てるのは知ってたんだ
records.en_original: Sorry... Actually, we already knew you were in Izumo, Hina.
records.en: Sorry... Actually, we already knew you were in Izumo, Hina.

records.jp: でも、ライムたちに会ったら<CR>辛い思いをするだろうから……
records.en_original: But we thought that if you saw us, it would make things even harder for you.
records.en: But we thought that if you saw us, it would make things even harder for you.

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: Why?
records.en: Why?

records.jp: ただでさえ、負わなくていい責任を負って<CR>大変な思いをしてるのに
records.en_original: You're already taking on burdens you shouldn't have to, going through enough as it is.
records.en: You're already taking on burdens you shouldn't have to, going through enough as it is.

records.jp: ライムたちに会ったら、ますます「尻拭い」を<CR>しなきゃって追い込まれちゃうかなって
records.en_original: If you saw us, you'd probably feel even more responsible.
records.en: If you saw us, you'd probably feel even more responsible.

records.jp: だって灰が降り出したのも、<CR>異灰が暴れ出したのも、全部、全部――
records.en_original: I mean, the Ash falling, the Testa going wild, all of it—it's all...
records.en: I mean, the Ash falling, the Testa going wild, all of it—it's all...

records.jp: 違う。ヒナちゃんのせいじゃない
records.en_original: No. It's not your fault, Hina.
records.en: No. It's not your fault, Hina.

records.jp: ヒナちゃんがあの時、ライムたちと一緒に<CR>決断してくれなかったら世界はとっくに終わってた
records.en_original: If you hadn't made that choice with us back then, the world would have ended a long time ago.
records.en: If you hadn't made that choice with us back then, the world would have ended a long time ago.

records.jp: ヒナちゃんのおかげで、希望を繋げたんだよ
records.en_original: Thanks to you, Hina, there's still hope.
records.en: Thanks to you, Hina, there's still hope.

records.jp: でも、もう終わりが迫ってる
records.en_original: But...the end is already closing in.
records.en: But...the end is already closing in.

records.jp: 確かにそう。<CR>この世界には時間がほとんど残ってない
records.en_original: That's right. There's hardly any time left for this world.
records.en: That's right. There's hardly any time left for this world.

records.jp: ……１個だけ方法があるよ。<CR>今日はそれを相談しに来たの
records.en_original: There's one way left. That's what I came to talk about today.
records.en: There's one way left. That's what I came to talk about today.

records.jp: 本当に？　教えて！
records.en_original: Really? Tell me!
records.en: Really? Tell me!

records.jp: リフレクタ―たちの想いを集めて……<CR>一つの新しい世界、“雫世界”を創る
records.en_original: If we gather the feelings of the Reflectors...we can create a brand new world, the Oasis.
records.en: If we gather the feelings of the Reflectors...we can create a brand new world, the Oasis.

records.jp: リフレクタ―？<CR>それって、詩みたいな者たちのことか？
records.en_original: Reflectors? Are they people like Uta?
records.en: Reflectors? Are they people like Uta?

records.jp: リフレクタ―っていうのは、簡単に説明すると、<CR>ヒナちゃんみたいに指輪を使って変身する子たちのこと
records.en_original: Reflectors are, simply put, girls who transform using rings, just like Hina.
records.en: Reflectors are, simply put, girls who transform using rings, just like Hina.

records.jp: 詩ちゃんもリフレクターではあるけど、種類が違う。<CR>あの子とヒナちゃんたちの指輪は別物
records.en_original: Uta is a Reflector too, but she's a different kind. Her ring isn't the same as Hina's and the others'.
records.en: Uta-chan is a Reflector too, but she's a different kind. Her ring isn't the same as Hina's and the others'.

records.jp: ふむ……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: そして、集めたリフレクターたちの想いを元に……<CR>この世界を再現する
records.en_original: Then we use the collected feelings of the Reflectors as the foundation to recreate this world.
records.en: Then we use the collected feelings of the Reflectors as the foundation to recreate this world.

records.jp: 完全に再現するのは難しいけど……<CR>少なくともこの世界は踏みとどまれる
records.en_original: Completely recreating everything will be tough, but at least this world won't fade away completely.
records.en: Completely recreating everything will be tough, but at least this world won't fade away completely.

records.jp: やば。すごいこと思いつくじゃん
records.en_original: Dang. That's an amazing idea.
records.en: Dang. That's an amazing idea.

records.jp: それって、もしかして……<CR>かなり危険なことなんじゃない？
records.en_original: But isn't that actually really dangerous?
records.en: But isn't that actually really dangerous?

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 雫世界を創るために消費された子たちは、<CR>最悪、犠牲になる
records.en_original: Reflectors who pour their feelings into creating the Oasis could end up as sacrifices if things go badly.
records.en: Reflectors who pour their feelings into creating the Oasis could end up as sacrifices if things go badly.

records.jp: 想いを捧げてくれる人数が多ければ<CR>一人当たりの負担は減るから、犠牲になる可能性も減る
records.en_original: If more people are willing to give their feelings, the load on each person is lighter, and the risk of losing anyone goes down.
records.en: If more people are willing to give their feelings, the load on each person is lighter, and the risk of losing anyone goes down.

records.jp: でも、今お願いできるのは……<CR>ヒナちゃんと、あと何人かだけ
records.en_original: But for now, the only ones I can ask are Hina and a few others.
records.en: But for now, the only ones I can ask are Hina and a few others.

records.jp: ……本当はヒナちゃんにそんな危険なことさせたくない
records.en_original: Honestly, I don't want you taking such a risk, Hina.
records.en: Honestly, I don't want you taking such a risk, Hina.

records.jp: それに雫世界を創るということは、<CR>この世界を一旦全て消滅させるということ
records.en_original: And creating the Oasis means this world will have to be erased first.
records.en: And creating the Oasis means this world will have to be erased first.

records.jp: このままだと消えちゃう運命だとしても……<CR>抵抗があるよね
records.en_original: Even if it's already fated to disappear, it still feels wrong.
records.en: Even if it's already fated to disappear, it still feels wrong.

records.jp: この世界のためとはいえ、悪者になるわけだから
records.en_original: No matter the reason, we'll become the villains in everyone's eyes.
records.en: No matter the reason, we'll become the villains in everyone's eyes.

records.jp: でも、いっぱい色々考えたけど、<CR>これしか方法はないんだ
records.en_original: Still, I've thought it through from every angle, but there's just no other way.
records.en: Still, I've thought it through from every angle, but there's just no other way.

records.jp: やろう
records.en_original: Let's do it.
records.en: Let's do it.

records.jp: この世界を少しでも残せる可能性があるなら、<CR>挑戦したい
records.en_original: If there's any chance to save even a piece of this world, I want to try.
records.en: If there's any chance to save even a piece of this world, I want to try.

records.jp: 私はこの時のために、ずっと生きてきたと思ってるから
records.en_original: I feel like I've been living all my life for this moment.
records.en: I feel like I've been living all my life for this moment.

records.jp: それに……
records.en_original: And also...
records.en: And also...

records.jp: ユズとライムが悪者になるなら、私も一緒に悪者になる
records.en_original: If you two become villains, then I'll become one too.
records.en: If you two become villains, then I'll become one too.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Hina...
records.en: Hina...

records.jp: ごめんね。<CR>ヒナちゃんを危険な目に遭わせることになって
records.en_original: Sorry. I know I'm putting you in danger, Hina.
records.en: Sorry. I know I'm putting you in danger, Hina.

records.jp: でも……
records.en_original: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: ヒナちゃんなら、そう言ってくれると思ってた
records.en_original: I just knew you would say that.
records.en: I just knew you would say that.

records.jp: ライム！？
records.en_original: Lime?!
records.en: Lime?!

records.jp: 消えた……？
records.en_original: She's gone?
records.en: She's gone?

records.jp: 回線切断でもされたのか……？
records.en_original: Did the connection just drop?
records.en: Did the connection just drop?

records.jp: もしかして……
records.en_original: Wait, could it be...
records.en: Wait, could it be...

records.jp: な、なんですか、あれ……
records.en_original: Wh-what is that?
records.en: Wh-what is that?

records.jp: これのせいか……
records.en_original: Is that what's causing this?
records.en: Is that what's causing this?

records.jp: みんな、急いで向かおう
records.en_original: Everyone, let's hurry!
records.en: Everyone, let's hurry!
